mapper.select: SELECT hour.*, com.name AS companyName, pro.name AS productName,dsp.name AS dspName FROM data_dsp_slot_hour AS hour LEFT JOIN dsp_slot_info AS dsp ON dsp.id = hour.dsp_slot_id LEFT JOIN dsp_company AS com ON dsp.company_id = com.id LEFT JOIN dsp_product AS pro ON dsp.product_id = pro.id WHERE hour.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND hour.date = #{date} ORDER BY hour.id DESC
